readout_other: laser speckle imaging; neurological severity score; Nissl staining; VEGF immunohistochemistry
direction_notes: TBI mice receiving tFUS had higher relative CBF and lower NSS than untreated TBI mice across 14 days.

target.label: target region in the injured cortical areas

timing.protocol_description: Unfocused transducer with conical collimator over the injured cortex; total stimulation duration 10 min daily for 14 consecutive days. SD 400 ms, TBD 0.5 ms, PRF 1 kHz.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Mice were randomly divided into three groups: the Sham group(n = 6), the TBI group(n = 16), and the TBI + tFUS group(n = 16).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: tFUS was administered daily for 10 min and for 14 consecutive days after TBI.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The total stimulation duration was 10 min.The ultrasound fundamental frequency (FF) and pulsed repetition frequency (PRF) were 500  kHz and 1  kHz, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The total stimulation duration was 10 min.The ultrasound fundamental frequency (FF) and pulsed repetition frequency (PRF) were 500  kHz and 1  kHz, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The ultrasound stimulation duration (SD) and tone-burst duration (TBD) were 400 ms and 0.5 ms, respectively [24].
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The ultrasound stimulation duration (SD) and tone-burst duration (TBD) were 400 ms and 0.5 ms, respectively [24].
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.isppa_w_: The ultrasound pressure was measured by a calibrated needle-type hydrophone (HNR500; Onda,USA), and the spatial peak average intensity (Isppa) was 2.6 W/cm2.(Table 1).
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: The pulsed signal from the second generator was amplified using a linear power amplifier (E&I240 L; ENI Inc., USA) and transmitted to an unfocused ultrasound transducer (V301-SU; Olympus, Japan).
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: The pulsed signal from the second generator was amplified using a linear power amplifier (E&I240 L; ENI Inc., USA) and transmitted to an unfocused ultrasound transducer (V301-SU; Olympus, Japan).
